items.name: A. Shift held: the FM-1's buttons on the pads (columns 7-8)
items.description: The Shift screen's 2 x 4 grid is the pads of columns 7-8, pad for name: KEY LOCK / LATCH PERF / B.PRF FX / BASS BEAT. Tap: on / off; held: its settings. S2 Settings, S8 sound editor (icons lit).

meta.label: SOUND
meta.function: Home: the chord sound. Click: turning picks the preset <-> the engine (the screen says which). In a settings layer: its pages. In the Editor: its screens and lanes.
meta.turn: The chord preset (or engine, after a click)
meta.shiftTurn: The bass sound (Shift + click: the bass preset <-> engine)
meta.touch: The sound's name

meta.label: SEQ PLAY
meta.function: The sequencer (the looper's slot): play / stop from step 1.
meta.shift: Shift + Play: restart from step 1

meta.label: SEQ REC
meta.function: Records what is played into the loop, live, in the record mode (Overwrite, Advance, Overdub, Replace, Step).
meta.shift: Shift + Rec: the next record mode

meta.label: LOOP
meta.function: Tap: LATCH on / off. Held: the looper (the FM-1's PLAY menu): the slots on the steps, the loop's settings on the knobs.
meta.hold: The slots and the loop settings

meta.label: COPY
meta.function: Held + a step with a chord: copied (more join); + an empty step: pasted. Let go after a copy: the next step tap pastes. Tapped alone: a waiting paste dropped, else the loop into the next empty slot.
meta.click: Drop a paste / copy the loop to a slot
meta.hold: Copy held + steps

meta.label: BASS
meta.function: The bass part on / off.
meta.shift: The bass sound's popup

meta.label: DELETE
meta.function: Held + a step: cut (the next step pastes it). Held + a memory: cleared. Held + Play: the loop cleared. Shift + Delete: PANIC.
meta.hold: Delete held + step / memory / Play
meta.shift: PANIC

meta.label: SHIFT
meta.function: Held: the steps are the FM-1's buttons (tap: on / off; held: the settings). Shift + the wheel: the bass sound. Shift + a mod: LOCK it.
meta.hold: The shortcuts on the steps and the screen

meta.label: OCT +
meta.function: The root pads an octave up (-2..+2).

meta.label: OCT -
meta.function: The root pads an octave down (-2..+2).

meta.label: PAGE <

meta.label: BACK
meta.function: Home, from anywhere (the Settings, a settings layer, the editor). While a Settings value is edited: done first. Touch Volume + Back: FM-1 mode.

meta.label: LAYOUT

meta.hold: Held: the pads become the picker: layouts, the 8 memory banks, the 16 progressions

meta.label: SOUND
meta.function: Home: the chord sound. Click: turning picks the preset <-> the engine (the screen says which). In a settings layer: its pages. In the Editor: its screens and lanes.

meta.shiftTurn: The bass sound (Shift + click: the bass preset <-> engine)
meta.touch: The sound's name

meta.label: SEQ PLAY
meta.function: The sequencer (the looper's slot): play / stop from step 1.
meta.shift: Shift + Play: restart from step 1

meta.label: SEQ REC
meta.function: Records what is played into the loop, live, in the record mode (Overwrite, Advance, Overdub, Replace, Step).
meta.shift: Shift + Rec: the next record mode

meta.label: LOOP

meta.hold: The slots and the loop settings

meta.label: COPY
meta.function: Held + a step with a chord: copied (more join); + an empty step: pasted. Let go after a copy: the next step tap pastes. Tapped alone: a waiting paste dropped, else the loop into the next empty slot.
meta.click: Drop a paste / copy the loop to a slot
meta.hold: Copy held + steps

meta.label: BASS
meta.function: The bass part on / off.
meta.shift: The bass sound's popup

meta.label: DELETE
meta.function: Held + a step: cut (the next step pastes it). Held + a memory: cleared. Held + Play: the loop cleared. Shift + Delete: PANIC.
meta.hold: Delete held + step / memory / Play
meta.shift: PANIC

meta.label: SHIFT
